name: forge-jedx
description: JEDx Data Model forge bundle — parses the JEDx per-entity CSVs and emits the universal forge property contract (DmeClass/DmeProperty/DmeOptionSet roles, synthetic jedx:<kind>/<key> stableIds, field->codeset HAS_OPTION_SET ownership, entity->entity REFERENCES, voyage-4-large embeddings). No CEDS crosswalk in source — naturally CEDS-pure.
